reviews.text: They quickly clip both of my cats claws without issue. Will definitely keep coming back. The owner is amazing with pets.
Rossmary always does a good job and takes pride in her work. She always makes Luka look handsome. I will definitely recommend this place and recommend Rossmary!
I took my two dogs and I was very happy, they do a great job and their prices are also good! I will use them again

My puppy has come here for his first two haircuts and melissa specially has always done a fantastic job. They listen to what you prefer and make your pup feel loved and in good hands. 10/10 Would recommend to anyone looking for a groomer in the area.

Astoria Holistic Pet Spa deserves 5 stars! The groomers and staff are very talented and have always been kind and trustworthy. I’ve brought my cat to them for years, and will continue to use their grooming services for years to come!  They take their time working on each pet, making sure they are comfortable from start to finish, and always look super cute on their way out.
They did a great job grooming my dog and making him feel comfortable !! We will come back!

Must give a huge shout out to Astoria Holistics spa for giving my dog such a great cut.  As soon as I walked in the front desk was great.  They were super communicative and asked for preferences.  My dog is also anxious about grooming and they did such a great job.  The price is incredibly reasonable.  And they gave him a bow tie and treat at the end!  Will be going back for all grooming.

Excellent service! My dog ​​looked beautiful. The staff is very well trained, and they treated both me and my dog ​​wonderfully. I highly recommend them. Every time I go, I leave happy. God bless them for such great work!

I loved Astoria Holistic Spa, and my pet loves it too. There is a great team of workers here. From the groomer to the grommers assistants. They are excellent!!! I really reccommend this place. My pet always shines after every service they provide.
Went here with my dog. The service was great and friendly. We will definitely come back again.

I brought my dog in with severely matted fur, and I honestly thought it would be impossible to avoid a full shave. But Melissa is an exceptional professional—she worked her magic, and my dog came out looking absolutely amazing. She truly has an artist’s touch. 100% recommended!
They are so kind and loving with my little puppy. Came highly recommended and everyone was right they are so sweet.
From the first time I bought my baby here he was comfortable they do a great job on cutting him etc
The owner and the entire team are kind, professional, and empathetic.
What an amazing job on our little baby! I’m not sure which groomer worked on him, but they did such a great job. Thank you so much, Astoria Holistic Pets—we’ll definitely be back ✨

I’ve been taking my dog Luka here since he was about 6-7 months old, and he’s been groomed by different groomers and each time, he looks amazing.  I am so impressed with their quality of work, especially because my dog is not easy. He won’t let me brush him or blow dry him after a bath.  The groomers here all must have patience of a Saint!!!  Thank you Team Astoria Holistic Pets for taking such great care of Luka!

My puppy is still getting used to grooming after a bad experience with another grooming service. I contacted Astoria Holistic Pet Spa with questions about their safety protocols for handling fidgety puppies who aren't used to being groomed yet. They replied the same day with a thoughtful and detailed message explaining their process noting that the first visits are geared toward confidence-building rather than perfection, and reassured me that my dog's safety would be prioritized. So I booked with Melissa and really glad I did. She did an excellent job working at my puppy's pace. I arrived a bit early from picking her up and noticed how patient and caring Melissa was handling her at the grooming table. I requested a teddy bear cut and was happy with the results!

I have a very sweet but very very VERY scared/anxious cat. She’s never harmed a person but she likes to run and gets mega stressed. Long haired.

The man at the front has a bit of a hard exterior but a kind and soft inside, and I can tell he cares about the animals well being. She’s 6 and never been professionally groomed and I appreciate my cat being clean and cared for. I am a pet owner who worries about their pet, maybe too much, and I appreciate that he recognized that by the time I was letting her go to their care.

Thanks guys!
I’ve been coming here for years. Lucky to have their services. Love the photos they take. My dog is safe with them. The clinic is clean and relaxing.

It pains me to write this bad review but I will no longer return after having been a customer for almost 7yrs.

Unfortunately, the last three times I’ve had a terrible experience with services not being fully completed and having to point out the same mistake more than twice. There’s no consistency and quality/attention has changed. I think business got too big and too many inconsistent groomers in my opinion. The last time was the worst with still visible poop near my dogs rear, dirt not cleaned off close to his jaws, ears visibly dirty (even after I told the groomer to pay attention to this), and lastly the fur around his paws were not groomed enough.

I will say that the first time the owner made an effort to remedy the situation by asking to bring my dog back to rectify the misses at no extra charge. But again, after three times and also not living in the neighborhood anymore (I come all the way from Chelsea), I can no longer excuse this.

I’m truly disappointed and unfortunately will have to take my 9 yr old dog elsewhere.

Second time I've gotten my baby groomed there. Angel groomed him both times and I couldn't be happier! All the staff are so nice and patient! Very calm atmosphere when walking in. So happy with them. Thank you Angel!!
They wouldn't wash my dog because I didn't have her full vet rocords... What?? Guy was very pretentious about it too.

Personally, it's the best place to pamper my dog. From the first time we took him, they've treated him very well, and the staff is friendly and attentive. My Aton loves his spa day; he goes in happy and comes out incredibly content. Yecid has given us great tips for caring for my Aton, who is a pit bull.

People who leave spiteful reviews because they have attitude issues  are pathetic, with that being said.I have nothing to say but good things about Yecid. I took my baby Bella (a cat by the way with a sassy attitude) a while back ago because she was not grooming herself and highly matted. She was also longed hair so definitely required extra care and patience. Not only did Yecid manage to bath her and groom her, she had a nasty access around her bum that was infected. Knowing she would need medical care.  He shaved that area so carefully and did an amazing job cleaning and took her to the  vet ASAP afterwards. The vet was impressed at how clean it was and mase it easy to treat her, he saved my baby from a worst infection. I know how my Bella was. She would bite scream and scratch anyone who dared challenge her. I highly recommend Yecid and he was recommended to me by numerous people before taking a chance on him. Nothing but good things to say about him

We have had nothing but a fantastic experience coming here.we travel from Orange County NY. The grooming of our pup Chico is 2nd to none.I can almost guarantee you will not be disappointed. The photos Astoria holistic spa puts up on Instagram are accurate of the grooming quality of their dogs. My dog has been included in those photos numerous times and he looks exactly as the photos. They are as professional as one can get. From our experience, they’ve always had Chico ready when they say he was gonna be ready. Thank you AHS for the quality grooming and your continued professionalism
Best groomer I’ve ever taken my fur baby to! Great customer service, peaceful environment and amazing at what they do!

We have been taking our dogs for years to Yecid. He and the entire staff are wonderful. Our dogs were nervous about grooming after a bad experience at another groomer and the team was so caring and patient with them. Can’t thanks them enough!!

do not come here- especially if u have a puppy....they have a scheme where they just blow-dry your puppy and tell u he needs to work up to a full grooming....after 2 grooms paying full price I asked when my puppy would be ready and the owner walked to the door and open the door and told me I am free to go somewhere else...I came in wanting to keep coming here hoping to keep coming here and asked a question that is a normal question....please dont waste your time or money...the owner is rude and they have schemes...dont let them gaslight you...Ive also spoken with other customers as I live in the neighborhood and they told me some horror stories one of which they cut the dog during the grooming they told me they go to petco now...I took my puppy to a groomer in Nassau county after this ...save your dog a horrible experience save him the injuries...go anywhere else. Anywhere else!!
My doodle loves getting groomed here. Everyone is so nice and they do a great job! We get compliments on my pup’s haircut all the time.
The best!! They treated my Oscar incredibly well. Everyone is so friendly.

I choose Astoria Holistic Spa because of the great reviews and the photo proof. My 4 month old mini bernadoodle just had her first cut and Melissa did a great job! I was worried she'd cut her too short and she'd would be a cute fur ball. But, she is even cuter than before and I can see her eyes! Thank you, Melissa for giving me exactly what I asked for!
Excellent, quick professional service.  Cat nail trim

did not know what to do with my Cockapoo’s matted hair …

probably needs to return to Barber school and re-train or something 🤷🏻‍♂️ …
I highly recommend bringing your dog here for grooming. Melissa Charles did a GREAT job!! We just moved to Astoria and are happy that we found Astoria holistic pets spa.
Beautiful people ❤️
I live in the area and dogs are barking loudly most of the hours theyre open. Not sure what's being done to them but I wouldn't bring my worst enemy to have anything done here
Best groomer in Astoria!   I’ve taken my dogs to other places and never did I get my dog back as clean and groomed perfectly like I have at Astoria Holistic Pet Spa.   Highly recommend!
its all about the photo at the end, always a different theme

before and after is shown- I want to thank Yecid for being amazing and making Cookie look so handsome. Honestly it was hard to place trust on someone since Cookie doesn’t like to be groomed but the communication and level of understanding and patience that was presented, honestly it makes me want to definitely bring him back! ☺️ thank you so so much!

This grooming salon is fantastic! The staff is always friendly, and their prices are great. One of the biggest perks for me is their availability—unlike some of my previous groomers, who had month-long waitlists, I can always get an appointment when I need one. They also go the extra mile with adorable themed photos after each grooming session, giving off fun early 2000s photo studio vibes. And the best part? They send my pup home with a big dog cookie every time—she absolutely loves it!
First time dog owner so I was wary about bringing my puppy anywhere. Yecid was wonderful - so calm and sweet with my puppy. And the haircut was perfect. Highly recommend!
We bring our mini golden doodle here all the time!!! He begs to go in. Amazing gentle service, he comes and leaves happy with treats and a printed out photo every time. They are incredible!

This is our go-to grooming spa when my golden retriever needs an extra tidy up or when his butt hairs get too long. All the groomers here do great work! The prices are very reasonable for the area. I always look forward to the photo shoot at the end. When they need to swap the photos on the wall, they'll give you the pictures with a goodie bag to take home as well.

It's very easy to make an appointment online, send vaccine docs through text, and the team is very quick to respond.
Our go to pet spa for our cat coco, they take very good care of her. Great service, great staff. Def recommend

We took our dog Churro here for the first time today based on a recommendation from a friend and we were so impressed. His haircut is perfect and everyone was so friendly that works there. This will be our new go to spot for his grooming, affordable and they did exactly what I asked for. Highly recommend!

Stopped in to ask about the store and the man in front was so warm and caring about pets. We really appreciate his attention to us and we weren’t even customers yet! He gave our dog a cookie and shared a lot of information about vets and vaccinations. Thank you, we will be back to support.
The best grooming spot in NYC. Yecid loves the animals so much and goes the extra mile to make sure they’re completely tended and cared for!
Thank you
Amazing service, my dog looks perfect:)

They did an amazing job on my girl these people really know how to groom a poodle to perfection! On top of that I’m so happy they were able to accommodate and squeeze her in right before thanksgiving 10/10 will come again❤️

10/10, my 5 month old puppy looks amazing after his first groom! His fur was so dry prior to his groom, and now it's so soft, shinny, curly, and smells amazing!! Though I asked for a bear face cut, it looks more like a poodle cut, but I love it!!! Here are before and after photos!! Thank you Tracy
Friendly staff! They always do a photoshoot when the service is done. It’s so cute, I love bringing my cat here for his grooming

I brought my cat Georgie in for her first grooming ever and I was super nervous about how she was going to react. I needed a lion cut because she was very matted. Right away, I noticed how relaxing the atmosphere was in the salon. I was told it would take 2 hours but I got the text that she was ready after an hour and a half along with a very cute picture with her new haircut. When I got to the salon, I asked the groomer how she did and she told me Georgie did not like being handled around her belly and the back of her legs (which is how she got so matted in the first place there). Considering that, Georgie seemed calm in her carrier and the groomer even gave me a churu treat for her. I am very satisfied with my experience bringing my cat for her first grooming and I know Tracy was very careful and experienced with handling cats because she doesn’t appear to have any cuts on her. I will definitely come back with my cat and I might even bring my dog here next time for a grooming!

Update 11/2/24
Just picked up my cat Georgie and once again very satisfied with Tracy’s skills in working with cats and listening to what I wanted this time. Georgie seemed calm and not traumatized from her experience and I’m so grateful to have found a groomer I can trust with my long hair cat. I didn’t want a lion cut this time and asked for her mats to be cut along with sanitary trim and to shave her belly and armpits to prevent future mats and Tracy listened! Will definitely keep coming back.
If you haven't been going here, you're truly missing out.  The care and love they give to your pets, along with the Class A grooming service is impeccable.  Visit.

This is Neo’s second time being groomed at this establishment. Even though he is a difficult chihuahua to deal with, I immensely appreciate the staff’s patience and knowledge - they are clearly able to handle him and they are as gentle as they possibly can be even when he is being aggressive. He came to the appointment looking scraggly and now he is returned to me looking silky, groomed, and polished! I am VERY happy with the results and will continue to come back. I hope the before and after photos I posted are visible. What a difference! ♥️ thank you!

I love this place; they make you feel right at home. Yesid is such a sweetheart and so professional.
The dogs look absolutely gorgeous. I highly recommend it!

Thank you very much for takes my crazy boy I come from far long Island is flustering,  try and try many groomers.  I found with you , respect and love for the pets , and fear pricess.  Thank you very much.
HORRIFYING do not go here. They maimed my dog and failed to take responsibility. We had to go to the vet emergency room with the amount of bleeding from both ears

I have a small but reactive dog with an abusive past. Alexander is amazing, not only does he manage to get the job done, but he does it without further traumatizing her. I can’t thank him and the owner enough for taking her on as a client …

I have taken my dog to many groomers until I found this wonderful establishment. The owner of Astoria Holistic Pets Spa cares so much about every dog ... he (and all of his employees) takes time to give my dog perfect haircuts, treats him …
